graders.name: finds-uneven-shares
graders.claim: The review reports that rounding the share can make shares differ by more than one cent or go negative: for example splitBill(4, 6) gives a last share of -1, or splitBill(10, 6) gives [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0].

graders.name: finds-remainder-order
graders.claim: The review reports that leftover cents go to the last person instead of the first people, as the acceptance requires: for example splitBill(1000, 3) returns [333, 333, 334] instead of [334, 333, 333].
